items.question: Which specific material offerings are included within the sixteenfold ritual worship?
premises: Incense and two lamps are presented as ritual offerings.
A food offering and betel are presented as ritual offerings.
Cool water is presented as a ritual offering.
items.inference: These items constitute part of the sixteenfold set of ritual services used in worship.
uncertainties: The exact enumeration position of these items within the full sixteen services is not specified in this verse alone.
